newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices ease on world trends.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices ease on world trends.

text.p: Prices on Istanbul's gold exchange fell on Tuesday in line with lower levels on European markets, dealers said.

Gold closed down $2.5 and 1,500 lira at $383.35 an ounce and 1,093,000 lira per gram. Price falls were smaller in lira terms due to a weak Turkish lira, which closed at 88,450 against the dollar after Monday's 87,940.
Traded volume plunged to 727 kilos from 1,376 on Monday, when free market demand was lifted by weekend jewellery sales.
Dealers said demand faded because buyers were sidelined amid nervousness on world markets after Monday's sell-off.
Only 120 kilos of gold changed hands in the second session against 607 in the morning.
No dollar deals were made in the afternoon and 71 percent of the total day's trade was in lira terms.
Exchange members import gold and prefer to sell it in lira when the lira depreciates sharply against the dollar.
